label: ASR 1001-X aggregation services router
description: 1 RU 2.5 Gbps - 10 Gbps aggregation router with a fixed ESP and eight built-in Ethernet ports: six 1G SFP-only interfaces and two 10G SFP+ interfaces (10G rate only, SyncE capable). One half-height SPA slot adds further LAN/WAN ports; no copper data ports are fitted, only the 10/100/1000 management port.
notes: Cisco ASR 1001-X Router Hardware Installation Guide: "Six built-in 1 GE SFP-only interfaces (do not support SFP+), and two built-in 10 GE SFP+ interfaces (support only 10-GE rate) that support SyncE". The front-panel port table numbers them GE 0/0/0-0/0/5 and 10GE 0/0/0-0/0/1, so Gi0/0/0-5 are 1G SFP cages that refuse a 10G optic and Te0/0/0-1 are 10G SFP+ pinned to 10G, because a 1G SFP in a 10G-only cage is the same mistake as a 10G optic in a 1G cage. The half-height SPA slot is empty in the base chassis (nine SPAs are orderable) so no SPA ports are modelled, and Gi0 is the separate 10/100/1000 management port. ESP: 2.5 Gbps default, 5/10/20 Gbps with a licence. This model was catalogued twice until issue #60: devices/cisco/asr1001-x.json held it under the compact spelling and modelled all eight built-in ports as 10G SFP+, so a 10G optic was accepted on the six 1G-only cages. That file is deleted - the compact form is the same device, its normalised key cisco|asr1001x is already taken, and adding it again will be refused by the importer and by test/hardware-invariants.test.js.
